# Oddsense integration attribution

The NewsAPI/social enrichment and cross-platform contextual market workflow was
informed by [jayeshvpatil/oddsense](https://github.com/jayeshvpatil/oddsense), version
0.2.1, studied at commit `a625a81ff84091c12148b9fb5c84893466aea282` on 2026-10-18.
The DRF integration is independently authored Python code using DRF's evidence,
budget, lifecycle and report contracts. It does not require the Rust CLI or copy
its sentiment-to-probability or fuzzy-arbitrage semantics.

Upstream is MIT-licensed. Its notice is reproduced for attribution; this notice
does not license provider data, publisher article content or third-party assets.
